title: This Teen Was Probably Never Told ‘No’ Growing Up
description:
What started as a potential DUI arrest spirals out of control in less than 10 minutes in Crystal Lake, Illinois. Ellie Masukevich made it very clear she was not happy when officers put her in handcuffs. She faces numerous charges in connection to this incident, including DUI and battery of a peace officer. She is scheduled to face trial in July.
